body:
Greg's decision on Windows B compiler crashes (2026-11-22 ~19:35Z, relayed verbatim by Engram::Asistant, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #2553): „Window B ma problemy. Trzeba powtarzać”. Rule, as the coordinator applies it (record on w-adfaa5aaacac):
(1) A rustc ICE or environment crash on Windows B, failing before any test result, is NOT a failure of the change. Repeat the run on the IDENTICAL input in a fresh root with a fresh target, record each attempt on w-adfaa5aaacac (run id, input, query, rustc version), and continue.
(2) A TEST failure is never repeated; it is investigated under the failed-gate rule.
(3) Two consecutive ICEs on the same input are reported to the TermAl coordinator before any third attempt.
(4) No toolchain change and no host restart without Greg's instruction.
Windows B rustc is 1.100.0 (0ef1bc386); Central is 1.99.1.
